mapper.select: select (select count(*) from erp_supplier) as supplierTotal, (select count(*) from erp_supplier where admission_status = 'PENDING') as supplierPending, (select count(*) from erp_contract where contract_status = 'ACTIVE') as contractActive, (select count(*) from erp_contract where contract_status = 'ACTIVE' and end_date is not null and end_date between curdate() and date_add(curdate(), interval 30 day)) as contractExpiring, (select count(*) from erp_purchase_request where request_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL') as requestPending, (select count(*) from erp_purchase_order where order_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL') as orderPending, (select count(*) from erp_purchase_order where order_status = 'APPROVED' and expected_date is not null and expected_date < curdate()) as orderOverdue, (select count(*) from erp_purchase_order where order_status = 'PARTIALLY_RECEIVED') as orderPartial, (select ifnull(sum(inventory_amount), 0) from erp_inventory_balance) as inventoryAmount, (select count(*) from erp_inventory_balance where available_quantity < #{threshold}) as lowStockCount, (select ifnull(sum(ri.qualified_quantity * ri.unit_cost), 0) from erp_receipt_item ri inner join erp_receipt r on r.id = ri.receipt_id where r.receipt_status = 'CONFIRMED' and date_format(r.receipt_date, '%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m')) as monthlyReceiptAmount, (select count(*) from erp_receipt where receipt_status = 'CONFIRMED') as receiptTotal

select 'PURCHASE_REQUEST' as businessType, r.id as businessId, r.request_no as businessNo, r.title as title, r.request_status as status, r.create_by as createBy, r.create_time as createTime from erp_purchase_request r where r.request_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' union all select 'PURCHASE_ORDER' as businessType, o.id as businessId, o.order_no as businessNo, s.supplier_name as title, o.order_status as status, o.create_by as createBy, o.create_time as createTime from erp_purchase_order o left join erp_supplier s on s.id = o.supplier_id where o.order_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' union all select 'CONTRACT' as businessType, c.id as businessId, c.contract_no as businessNo, c.contract_name as title, c.contract_status as status, c.create_by as createBy, c.create_time as createTime from erp_contract c where c.contract_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' union all select 'SUPPLIER' as businessType, sp.id as businessId, sp.supplier_code as businessNo, sp.supplier_name as title, sp.admission_status as status, sp.create_by as createBy, sp.create_time as createTime from erp_supplier sp where sp.admission_status = 'PENDING' order by createTime desc

select b.id as balanceId, b.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, b.material_id as materialId, m.material_code as materialCode, m.material_name as materialName, m.specification as specification, m.unit as unit, b.available_quantity as availableQuantity from erp_inventory_balance b left join erp_warehouse w on w.id = b.warehouse_id left join erp_material m on m.id = b.material_id where b.available_quantity < #{threshold} order by b.available_quantity asc limit 10

select date_format(r.receipt_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, count(distinct r.id) as receiptCount, ifnull(sum(ri.qualified_quantity * ri.unit_cost), 0) as amount from erp_receipt r left join erp_receipt_item ri on ri.receipt_id = r.id where r.receipt_status = 'CONFIRMED' and r.receipt_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval ${days} day) group by date_format(r.receipt_date, '%Y-%m-%d') order by statDate asc
select order_status as status, count(*) as total from erp_purchase_order group by order_status
